name: Lachung–Gangtok National Highway
significance: NH 310A is a branch of NH 310. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Lachung to Gangtok, and it meets NH 310 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 310 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Gangtok to Xiayadong
